name: Intercontinental Los Angeles Downtown
insider_take: Downtown LA's crown jewel rises 73 floors above the city, offering unparalleled urban sophistication in the heart of America's entertainment capital.
whats_special: This architectural marvel is the tallest hotel on the West Coast, featuring a dramatic LED spire that illuminates the LA skyline. The hotel occupies floors 70-73 of the Wilshire Grand Center, putting guests literally above the clouds with breathtaking 360-degree views stretching from the Pacific Ocean to the San Gabriel Mountains.
pro_tip: Book a room on the northeast side for stunning sunrise views over the downtown skyline, or request the southwest corner for epic sunset vistas toward Santa Monica and the ocean.
dont_miss: The rooftop bar Spire 73 - the highest open-air bar in the Western Hemisphere - and the hotel's prime location just steps from STAPLES Center, L.A. LIVE entertainment district, and the historic Grand Central Market. The nearby Angels Flight funicular railway offers a charming ride through downtown's cultural corridor.
pros: Premium downtown location with skyline views
Luxurious modern amenities and spacious rooms
Walking distance to major attractions and business district
cons: Premium pricing for downtown luxury positioning
Urban location with city noise considerations
